temporal_state_chain.observed: Jonathan admits that he has been hiding something and says he is in some trouble.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Christian believes Jonathan is hiding something important from him and feels anxious and suspicious.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes: his suspicion is confirmed, and the hidden issue is now identified as Jonathan being in trouble.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan has been hiding a serious trouble from him.
temporal_state_chain.intention: to get Jonathan to explain what is going on and to uncover the truth

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jonathan says the situation is complicated and he does not want to drag Christian in, but admits he could use support and resources to get out of the mess.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan has been hiding a serious trouble from him.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes: Christian learns Jonathan is willing to accept help and needs support/resources.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan is in complicated trouble and is willing to accept Christian's support.
temporal_state_chain.intention: to help and support Jonathan, and to face the problem together

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jonathan says he cannot be sure, might have gotten involved with the wrong people, but denies doing anything illegal himself; Jonathan trusts Christian to handle it carefully.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan is in complicated trouble and needs Christian's support; Christian now suspects it may be related to criminal activity.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes: his suspicion is partially confirmed and refined—Jonathan may be connected to wrong people, but he denies illegal activity.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan may be entangled with wrong or criminal-associated people, but he denies illegal acts; the truth remains unclear and needs discreet investigation.
temporal_state_chain.intention: to investigate discreetly without alarming Jonathan and to ensure his safety

temporal_state_chain.observed: Christian's investigation reveals that Jonathan is being framed, and he tells Jonathan that someone is trying to set him up.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan may be entangled with wrong people but denies illegal activity; Christian was investigating discreetly.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes: the investigation changes his belief from uncertainty or possible involvement to Jonathan being innocent and framed.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan is innocent and is being framed by someone.
temporal_state_chain.intention: to gather more evidence and clear Jonathan's name by proving his innocence

temporal_state_chain.observed: Christian identifies or learns that the real culprit is someone close to both him and Jonathan, and he tells Jonathan this.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan is innocent and being framed; Christian intends to prove it.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes: he now believes the person responsible is a trusted mutual acquaintance.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Someone close to both Christian and Jonathan is the real culprit and has betrayed them by framing Jonathan.
temporal_state_chain.intention: to confront the real culprit and bring them to justice
